license_required.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

name.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

type.quote: The West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board is continued. The board shall consist of 10 members appointed by the Governor

required.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

experience_source.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

exams.name: Contractor classification examination
exams.notes: Board holds at least one examination per calendar quarter for each specific classification of contractor.
exams.quote: Hold at least one examination in each calendar quarter for each specific classification of contractor, designate the time and place of the examinations, and notify applicants thereof

interval_years.quote: A license issued under the provisions of this article expires one year from the date on which it is issued.

required.quote: If continuing education or other requirements are made a condition of license reinstatement after lapse, suspension, or revocation, these requirements must be satisfied before the license is reissued.

available.quote: the board may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state

requirements.value: To the extent other states provide for similar reciprocal action; applicant must show qualifications equal to WV licensees; must certify compliance per 30-42-15(c); must pay required fee.
requirements.quote: To the extent that other states which provide for the licensing of contractors provide for similar action, the board may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state, and upon certification to the board as required by 30-42-15(c) of this code, and upon payment of the required fee.

exists.quote: The West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board is continued. The board shall consist of 10 members appointed by the Governor

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a license to engage in business in this state as a contractor in one of the classifications set out in this article.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation undertaken by the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment, without legal excuse, of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project with reasonable diligence, causing material injury to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence, thereby causing material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in a material respect without consent of contracting parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the parties to the contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate violation of the building laws or regulations of the state or any political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate violation of the building laws or regulations of the state or of any political subdivision thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay moneys when due for materials or services, or fraudulent denial of amounts owed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for any materials free from defect, or services rendered in connection with the persons operations as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license or in official licensing matters.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license or in connection with official licensing matters

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of the article or the rules of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or acting as a contractor by someone other than the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or as a contractor by a person other than the person to whom the license is issued except as an employee of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately acting with intent to evade the provisions of the article by aiding unlicensed persons or misusing licenses.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting with the intent to evade the provisions of this article by: (i) Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing work not commensurate with the general standard of the specific contractor classification or below applicable building or construction code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing work which is not commensurate with a general standard of the specific classification of contractor or which is below a building or construction code adopted by the municipality or county in which the work is performed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing a person or persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work as required by statute.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work in accordance with 30-42-10 of this code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to abide by an order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to abide by an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board

bonding_required.quote: The form of financial assurance may include, but is not limited to, a surety bond, a cash bond, a certificate of deposit, an irrevocable letter of credit, or performance insurance

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means a person who in any capacity for compensation, other than as an employee of another, undertakes, offers to undertake, purports to have the capacity to undertake, or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, structure, or excavation associated with a project, development, or improvement, or to do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith, where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means a person who in any capacity for compensation, other than as an employee of another, undertakes, offers to undertake, purports to have the capacity to undertake, or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, structure, or excavation associated with a project, development, or improvement

methods_authorized.quote: undertakes, offers to undertake, purports to have the capacity to undertake, or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, structure, or excavation

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The contractors license number shall be included in all contracting advertisements and all fully executed and binding contracts.

contract_must_be_written.quote: No person licensed under the provisions of this article may perform contracting work of an aggregate value of $10,000 or more, including materials and labor, without a written contract, setting forth a description and cost of the work to be performed, signed by the licensee and the person for whom the work is to be performed.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: After the effective date of this article no municipality, local government, or county may require any additional occupational license or other evidence of competence as a contractor from any person, firm, or corporation who or which holds a valid and current license issued pursuant to this article, as a condition precedent to permission for the performance of contractor work in such municipality, local government jurisdiction, or county.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A license issued under the provisions of this article expires one year from the date on which it is issued.
